name: MonarchCombobox
title: Combobox
wrapsNative: Button field that presents a .sheet with a NavigationStack, a List of Buttons and .searchable(text:placement:prompt:)
summary: A field for choosing one value from a long list, searched in a sheet: grouped options with descriptions, hints and icons, a clear option and an optional create option.
whenToUse: For one choice out of more options than a Picker menu shows comfortably, such as a country, a customer or an assignee, especially when people know what to type.
whenNotToUse: Not for a few options (use Picker), not for several values (use MonarchTagInput or MonarchCheckboxGroup), and not for free search of content (use .searchable on the screen).
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, options: [MonarchComboboxOption], prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, clearOptionTitle: String? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, isClearable: Bool = true, isReadOnly: Bool = false, sortsByMatch: Bool = false, limit: Int? = nil, searchText: Binding<String>? = nil, labels: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels(), filter: (@Sendable (MonarchComboboxOption, String) -> Bool)? = nil, onCreate: (@MainActor (String) -> MonarchComboboxOption?)? = nil, loadError: String? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchComboboxOption: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable { init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, hint: String? = nil, group: String? = nil, keywords: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, leadingText: String? = nil, labelLanguage: Locale.Language? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false) }

struct MonarchComboboxLabels { init(search: String? = nil, loading: String? = nil, empty: String? = nil, create: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, more: (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, cancel: String? = nil, clear: String? = nil, noSelection: String? = nil, loadFailed: String? = nil, field: MonarchFormFieldLabels = MonarchFormFieldLabels()) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and is the title of the sheet.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the chosen option, or nil.

options.name: options
options.description: The options in order: id, label, description, hint, group, keywords, systemImage and isDisabled.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: helper
options.description: Help text under the field, also read as the hint.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: clearOptionTitle
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection, such as "Unassigned". Hidden while searching.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the hint.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a progress row with "Loading…" in the list, for options that are being fetched.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Shows a clear button in the field while something is chosen.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows the chosen label as selectable text in the field box, with Read only in the hint. It does not open the list and has no clear button.

options.name: sortsByMatch
options.description: While searching, lists labels that start with the text first, then labels with a word that does, then the rest, keeping the order within each.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many matches, with "Showing 50 of 120. Type to narrow the list."

options.name: searchText
options.description: The search text, for apps that search a server: bind it, pass a filter that keeps every option, and update options and isLoading from it.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings.

options.name: filter
options.description: Decides whether an option matches the trimmed search text. By default the label, hint and keywords are searched, ignoring case and accents.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Offers "Create “text”" when no label equals the typed text. Return the new option to choose it; return nil to only close the sheet.

options.name: loadError
options.description: Shown in the list in place of the options when they failed to load; empty uses "Couldn’t load the options."

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Offers Try again beside loadError.

options.name: option.leadingText
options.description: Decorative text before an option's label, such as a flag emoji. Not read by VoiceOver.

options.name: option.labelLanguage
options.description: The language an option's label is written in, so VoiceOver reads an endonym in its own language.

states.name: empty
states.description: The prompt in the subtle text role; VoiceOver reads the value "None".

states.name: chosen
states.description: The option's label in the default text role, and a clear button when clearable.

states.name: open
states.description: A sheet at medium or large height with the search field, the options in groups, a check mark on the chosen one, and Cancel.

states.name: no match
states.description: "No matches", or the create row when onCreate is set.

states.name: loading
states.description: A progress indicator and "Loading…" at the end of the list.

states.name: error
states.description: The danger border and the message with an icon, announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With .disabled(true): the disabled fill and text roles; the field cannot be opened.

appearance: The field matches MonarchTextField: surface fill, input border and control radius, the danger strong border for an error, disabled roles when disabled. In the list, labels use the default text role, descriptions and hints the muted role, disabled options the disabled role and the check mark the accent strong role. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web shows the list in a popover under a typing field, with keyboard navigation (arrows, Home, End, Page Up and Down). On iPhone a long list belongs in a sheet with the system search field, so the field is a button and typing happens in .searchable. Planned coverage named a searchable List in a sheet; that is what this is. Only single selection is offered: for several values use MonarchTagInput or MonarchCheckboxGroup. The web's onSearch with built-in debounce and abort is replaced by binding searchText and running the search in the app, for example with .task(id:), which SwiftUI cancels when the text changes. Free media is a systemImage, and renderOption has no equivalent. The inline mode is not offered: the sheet is already a full picker. Several closures are optional (filter, onCreate, onRetry). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is filter.
accessibility: The field is a button labelled with label, whose value is the chosen label or "None" and whose hint is the error ("Error: …"), the help text and "Required"; a new error is announced.
The clear button is a separate button named "Clear" with a 44-point touch target.
In the sheet each option is one button read with its label, description and hint; the chosen option has the selected trait and a check mark.
Disabled options cannot be chosen and use the disabled text role.
Icons are decorative; the label names the option.
edgeCases: A selection that is not in options shows the label remembered from an earlier choice, or else the raw id.
The search text is cleared when the sheet closes.
Groups keep the order in which they first appear; options without a group come first.
With a limit, matches are cut before grouping, and the note says how many matched.

examples.title: Searchable picker
examples.template:
MonarchCombobox(
    {{label}},
    selection: $timeZone,
    options: [
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.0.value}}, label: {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.1.value}}, label: {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.2.value}}, label: {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.3.value}}, label: {{options.3.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.4.value}}, label: {{options.4.label}}, description: {{options.4.description}}),
    ],
    prompt: {{placeholder}}
)
examples.code:
MonarchCombobox(
    "Time zone",
    selection: $timeZone,
    options: [
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "asia-kolkata", label: "Asia/Kolkata"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "europe-london", label: "Europe/London"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "america-new-york", label: "America/New_York"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "asia-tokyo", label: "Asia/Tokyo"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "utc", label: "UTC", description: "Coordinated Universal Time"),
    ],
    prompt: "Search"
)

examples.title: An assignee with a clear option
examples.code:
MonarchCombobox(
    "Assignee",
    selection: $assignee,
    options: [
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "sam", label: "Sam Lee", description: "Design", systemImage: "person.crop.circle"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "ada", label: "Ada Byron", description: "Engineering", systemImage: "person.crop.circle"),
    ],
    clearOptionTitle: "Unassigned"
)
